_README: Hand-maintained dungeon scene id -> final boss monster id (issue #201).
Unlike every other file in this directory this one is NOT vendored from
upstream and is NOT rewritten by `gen-name-tables.py --refresh`: nothing
in BPSR-ZDPS or either community tracker maps a dungeon to its boss, so
this is curation, by hand, from what a real run of the dungeon shows.
Only add a dungeon that has exactly ONE boss. This table supplies the
header caption *before* (or without) a boss hit; once a boss is actually
engaged the live hit-based lock in `Meter::recompute_boss` takes over and
outranks it. A dungeon with several bosses has no single right answer
before the pull, and a raid (`phase::BOSS_SELECT_SCENES`) is suppressed
`scene` and `boss` are documentation AND a guard: `gen-name-tables.py`
fails if either stops matching the generated name tables, so a game patch
that renames or re-ids something is caught instead of silently shipping a
wrong caption. Copy them verbatim from `scene_name` / `monster_name`.
After editing: `python3 scripts/gen-name-tables.py && cargo fmt -p bpsr-meter`.
